subject: Re: Shorten customer tour day — proposing a split hybrid walkthrough
messages:
From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@pacificint.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Miller <devon.miller@pacificint.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Customer tour day compressing — can we shorten Friday demo?

Hi Sofia,

Quick heads up — our client-facing tour on Friday got squeezed. A shipment delay and a late outbound flight mean the core team will only be on-site for a 2.5 hour window instead of the planned full afternoon. They still want Redwood content, but need it shorter and sharper.

Options they'd consider:
- A focused 30–35 minute walkthrough of the platform highlights (ops, latency/cost controls, Dedicated options), then hand off to a recorded deeper demo; or
- Asynchronous pre-recorded demo + a 20–30 minute live Q&A at the end of the day; or
- Keep a 45-minute live session but move to the morning (less likely given travel).

Can you advise what you recommend and whether you or a colleague can make an earlier or tighter window? I attached the current site itinerary.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Tran
Program Manager, Partnerships
Pacific Integrations
Attachments: site_visit_itinerary.xlsx
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@pacificint.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer tour day compressing — can we shorten Friday demo?

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and the itinerary.

Short answer: yes — we can make this work without losing the key decision points. Quick proposals below (pick one and I will send a final agenda):

1) High-impact split (preferred) - 25 minute focused demo covering: serving/runtime highlights, cost controls (Optimize), and Dedicated capabilities; followed immediately by 20 minute live "office hours" for deep technical Qs. We record the 25 minute walkthrough and share the link for their wider team.
2) Async + live Q&A - We ship a 12–15 minute recorded summary (prepped today) and do a 30 minute live Q&A at 3:00 PM local. Good when stakeholders are on differing travel schedules.
3) Condensed live only - 40 minute live walkthrough with Jonas standing by for deeper infra questions.

Availability: I can do an afternoon 14:30–15:30 PT slot (tight), or 10:00–11:00 PT earlier that day. Jonas, are you able to cover a 15:00–15:30 PT office hours slot if I run the walkthrough at 14:30?

If you confirm option 1 or 2 I will attach a pared-down agenda and a short "what we'll record" memo.

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183
Attachments: proposed_agenda.pdf
